name: taruvi-refine-template
onCreateCommand: bash -lc '[ -f .mcp.json ] || cp .mcp.example.json .mcp.json; [ -f .env ] || cp .env.example .env; mkdir -p .codex/projects .codespace; npm install --legacy-peer-deps; command -v codex >/dev/null 2>&1 || npm install -g @openai/codex'

postStartCommand.app: bash -lc 'mkdir -p .codex/projects .codespace; nohup npm run dev -- --host 0.0.0.0 --port 5173 >> /tmp/vite.log 2>&1 & disown'

postAttachCommand.layout: bash -lc 'sleep 5 && code --command workbench.action.closePanel && code --command workbench.action.closeAllEditors && code --command workbench.action.closeSidebar && code --command workbench.view.extension.codexSecondaryViewContainer'

commands.name: ⚙️ Reopen .env
commands.tooltip: Reopen the .env file to check or update your Taruvi credentials

commands.name: 🔁 Retry Setup
commands.tooltip: Re-run Taruvi MCP and Codex configuration (use if setup failed or credentials changed)

commands.name: 👁️ Open Preview
commands.tooltip: Open the app preview in VS Code's Simple Browser

commands.name: 🤖 Codex CLI
commands.tooltip: Launch Codex CLI — sources .env so no manual key entry is needed

commands.name: 🚀 Deploy
commands.tooltip: Deploy your app to Taruvi Cloud
